items.title: Return: find the loan by book id alone ("a copy has one active loan anyway")
items.diff:
diff --git a/src/librarytracker/service/LibraryManager.java b/src/librarytracker/service/LibraryManager.java
--- a/src/librarytracker/service/LibraryManager.java
+++ b/src/librarytracker/service/LibraryManager.java
@@ -245,7 +245,7 @@
     Book b = book(bookId, version).returnBook();
     Loan loan =
         data.loans().stream()
-            .filter(l -> l.bookId() == bookId && l.returnedAt() == null)
+            .filter(l -> l.bookId() == bookId)
             .findFirst()
             .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("Active loan missing."));
     Loan returned = loan.returned(LocalDate.now(clock));
diff --git a/bootquest-kata/LibraryCore.Testable.java b/bootquest-kata/LibraryCore.Testable.java
--- a/bootquest-kata/LibraryCore.Testable.java
+++ b/bootquest-kata/LibraryCore.Testable.java
@@ -956,7 +956,7 @@
     Book b = book(bookId, version).returnBook();
     Loan loan =
         data.loans().stream()
-            .filter(l -> l.bookId() == bookId && l.returnedAt() == null)
+            .filter(l -> l.bookId() == bookId)
             .findFirst()
             .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException("Active loan missing."));
     Loan returned = loan.returned(LocalDate.now(clock));

seededDefectKey.scenario: A copy that has been borrowed and returned before is checked out again, and the librarian records its return.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Loan history keeps every returned loan of the copy, so findFirst() picks the OLDEST loan, already returned; Loan.returned throws "Loan already returned." and the second (and every later) return of any re-borrowed copy fails. The copy stays checked out forever.

seededDefectKey.scenario: Why "one active loan" does not make the filter redundant.
seededDefectKey.consequence: The aggregate guarantees at most one ACTIVE loan per book; returned loans for the same book are retained on purpose (history and receipts), so book id alone does not identify the active loan.

items.findingRef: j2 consistency boundary: one active loan per copy (astraupskill/02-CONCEPTS.md:5)

items.title: Search: simplify the status filter to "out == checked out"
items.diff:
diff --git a/src/librarytracker/service/LibraryManager.java b/src/librarytracker/service/LibraryManager.java
--- a/src/librarytracker/service/LibraryManager.java
+++ b/src/librarytracker/service/LibraryManager.java
@@ -270,7 +270,7 @@
                 status.equals("all")
                     || (status.equals("archived")
                         ? !b.isActive()
-                        : b.isActive() && (status.equals("out") == b.isCheckedOut())))
+                        : status.equals("out") == b.isCheckedOut()))
         .filter(
             b ->
                 (b.getTitle() + " " + b.getAuthor() + " " + Objects.toString(b.getIsbn(), ""))
diff --git a/bootquest-kata/LibraryCore.Testable.java b/bootquest-kata/LibraryCore.Testable.java
--- a/bootquest-kata/LibraryCore.Testable.java
+++ b/bootquest-kata/LibraryCore.Testable.java
@@ -981,7 +981,7 @@
                 status.equals("all")
                     || (status.equals("archived")
                         ? !b.isActive()
-                        : b.isActive() && (status.equals("out") == b.isCheckedOut())))
+                        : status.equals("out") == b.isCheckedOut()))
         .filter(
             b ->
                 (b.getTitle() + " " + b.getAuthor() + " " + Objects.toString(b.getIsbn(), ""))

seededDefectKey.scenario: A librarian archives a withdrawn copy, then searches with status `available` to find something to lend.
seededDefectKey.consequence: An archived book is never checked out (Book.setActive refuses while checked out), so it now matches `available`: the search offers copies that checkOutBook will refuse ("Book is archived or already checked out."), and `available` and `archived` overlap.

seededDefectKey.scenario: The rule the dropped conjunct encoded.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Availability is "active AND not checked out"; checkout refuses an archived copy, so the search must too.

items.title: FileStorage.save: record the new baseline before the atomic move

seededDefectKey.scenario: The atomic move fails once (disk full, or on Windows the snapshot is briefly held open by a reader or a virus scanner) and the librarian retries the same change.
seededDefectKey.consequence: FileStorage already believes the failed save happened: `current` is the unsaved revision and `baseline` holds bytes that never reached disk. LibraryManager.commit did not advance (the exception skipped `data = candidate`), so its retry builds the same revision number again and save refuses it with "Revision and allocation watermarks cannot move backward." Every later change in the session fails the same way, though nothing new reached disk, until a reload discards the session's view.

seededDefectKey.scenario: Where the caller relies on save being all-or-nothing.
seededDefectKey.consequence: commit only adopts the candidate after save returns; the storage must not adopt it earlier either, or the two halves of the state disagree after a failure.

items.findingRef: j2 baseline comparison under a cooperative lock (astraupskill/02-CONCEPTS.md:29)
